about: Reviewed rewordings for tree packs (docs/tree/tree-packs.md, "Rewordings"). tree-pack learns a pair from GGG's own data: a node or mastery effect in both the older export and the bundle whose lines differ in one line each way with the same numbers. A learned pair is applied only when it is accepted here; a rejected or unlisted one leaves its lines unread. Same numbers do not prove the same stat: GGG changes a node's mechanic and keeps its values, so only changes of wording alone are accepted. Templates write each number as #.

accepted.why: "Global" dropped from the wording; the same nodes, values, and names.

accepted.old: #% increased Global Accuracy Rating while you have at least # nearby Ally
accepted.current: #% increased Accuracy Rating while you have at least # nearby Ally

accepted.old: #% increased Global Critical Strike Chance while wielding a Staff
accepted.current: #% increased Critical Strike Chance while wielding a Staff

accepted.old: You gain Added Lighting Damage instead of Added Damage of other types if Intelligence exceeds both other Attributes
accepted.current: You gain Added Lightning Damage instead of Added Damage of other types if Intelligence exceeds both other Attributes

accepted.old: Gain a random shrine buff every # seconds
accepted.current: Gain a random Shrine buff every # seconds

accepted.old: Banner Buffs Linger on you for # seconds after you leave the Area
accepted.current: Your Banner Buffs Linger on you for # seconds after you leave the Area
accepted.why: "Your" added; the banners were always the player's.

accepted.old: Arcane Surge grants #% more Spell Damage to you
accepted.current: Arcane Surge also grants #% more Spell Damage to you

accepted.old: each Herald affecting you, up to #%
accepted.current: each Herald affecting you, up to a maximum of #%
accepted.why: "a maximum of" added; the cap is the same.

accepted.old: Skills that would Summon a Totem have #% chance to Summon two Totems instead
accepted.current: Skills that Summon a Totem have #% chance to Summon two Totems instead of one
accepted.why: Wording only; the chance and its outcome are the same.

rejected.why: Another stat: the node's mechanic changed.

rejected.current: #% increased Effect of your Marks while Elusive

rejected.current: Every # seconds, remove Curses and Ailments from you
